sentences.en: I read Forbes every month to stay updated on business trends.
sentences.zh: 我每个月都会读《财富》杂志来了解最新的商业趋势。

sentences.en: The richest people in the world are featured in the Forbes list.
sentences.zh: 世界上最富有的人会在《福布斯》富豪榜上出现。

sentences.en: Forbes magazine recently published a special report on technology startups.
sentences.zh: 《财富》杂志最近发表了一份关于科技初创企业的特别报道。
